title: Event detail Activity names calendar diffs
lede: Football vs Eastern Michigan Activity rows from UWBadgers.com now name the field that changed. The Sep 2 update is a description/broadcast note, not a blank headline.

stats.n: The stored audit only differed on description (TV/radio notes). That value is now the supporting line.
All is selected by default so calendar updates are visible without switching filters.

sections.heading: After
sections.note: Authenticated after capture on Football vs Eastern Michigan (`/events/cmmgnauku006qx10lf8cg5fjk`), Admin, dark appearance, 1623×1345. Hash-bound pair receipts were not recorded for the earlier before-activity.png, so this is after-only rather than a matched pair. The before PNG in this folder shows the same Sep 2 row with no supporting line.

changes.was: Updated from UWBadgers.com with no field list, because the projector only inspected title/start/end/pickup/label.
changes.now: The row lists every changed field. This event’s Sep 2 and Aug 19 syncs recorded a description/broadcast note, so that is what Activity shows.

changes.was: A timing-locked republish of calendar start/end could write an audit with no displayed field, so Activity stayed blank.
changes.now: New sync audits include calendar start/end, all-day, and venue text. If a historical snapshot has no field evidence, the row says Calendar listing refreshed.

changes.was: Matching Student rows used a dash instead of 8:30 AM.
changes.now: Every Student row shows its call time. Open slots stay one row each. Activity opens on All.
